newsitem.title: UK: BTR extends gain after positive statement.
newsitem.headline: BTR extends gain after positive statement.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc on Monday continued Friday's advance, after comment in the Financial Times Lex column following a positive trading statement from the industrial conglomerate.
The stock was up 11-1/2p at 249 by 0847 GMT, after on Friday rising 7p -- the only FTSE 100 stock to show a gain on the day.
The Financial Times' Lex column said that last week's trading statement suggested the worst of BTR's problems were over and that profits should grow at an average rate next year.
BTR said in the statement last week that second half performance should show an improvement over the first six months trading. BTR's profits and dividend fell sharply in the first half of the year.
The newspaper commented that the shares could merit a re-rating as they are currently trading at a prospective price/earnings ratio of more than 20 percent below the market average.
